hook: Most teams struggle to score three, but Italian Serie A side Como just netted nine.

sections.voiceover: Most teams struggle to score three, but Italian Serie A side Como just netted nine.
At Stade Bollaert-Delelis, Cesc Fabregas led his squad to a massive 9-1 Champions League win against Lens. How did they score so many?
Como didn't stop there, converting an expected goals value—a shot-quality metric—of 4.18 into nine goals.
Greek striker Anastasios Douvikas led the charge, scoring a hat-trick for the visiting Como side. Como turned 18 total shots, including 12 on target, into a historic nine-goal performance.
Como wasn't slowing down, matching the UEFA Champions League record for most goals with that 9-1 scoreline.
